newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ reforms can help offset strong currency - finmin.
newsitem.headline: NZ reforms can help offset strong currency - finmin.

text.p: New Zealand's Finance Minister Bill Birch said on Wednesday he believed continued moves to reform government efficiency could help ease the pressure on some sectors caused by the rising NZ dollar.
"Reforms which improve our efficiency remain crucial to the government's agenda," he said in the prepared text of a speech given to a business conference in the North Island town of Hamilton.
Birch noted that some farming business sectors and manufacturing exporters were feeling pressure on profits as a result of current economic conditions that include a strong currency.
